data.name: Ephemeral
data.detailed_description:
This game crafts a medieval - themed town with a low - poly cartoon art style and establishes a casual collection system centered around “no combat, just exploration”. Players take on the role of a sword - wielding adventurer (the weapon is merely for decoration and has no attacking function) and can freely move through scenes featuring cobblestone streets and scattered wood - and - stone buildings. The core objective is to search for treasure chests scattered all over the town.

Different from traditional adventure games, there are no monster chases or combat pressure here. Instead, players get to enjoy“the pleasure of discovery”: every time a treasure chest is picked up, the number above the player’s head increases, urging them to explore the details of the map. From the flag - decorated marketplaces and taverns with towers to the alleys near the city walls, each area is full of clever design ideas. The scenes use bright color schemes, and the low - poly models create a visual sense that is both nostalgic and fresh, building a peaceful exploration atmosphere.

The game has a relaxed rhythm, making it suitable for fragmented gameplay. You can stroll through the streets at a slow pace and enjoy the puzzle - like fun of“treasure hunting”; or you can focus on finding the locations of hidden chests to satisfy your compulsion to collect. It’s more like a “micro - adventure in a town”. With simple rules, it magnifies the pure joy of “exploration and gain”, enabling players to immerse themselves in uncovering all the secrets of this virtual town in a stress - free environment.

Game Controls:

Movement = WASD

Jump = Spacebar
